findings.title: container.GatedOCClaims masks the T12 settle face: the production wiring never settles durable dispatch records
findings.reproduction: was red before the fix (fresh RED captured pre-fix, exit 1); the probe now asserts BOTH the settled record and the raised delivery-mark fence
findings.impact: Execute silently takes the pre-T12 finish order; records of successful dispatches go stale after 90s and the sweep parks them unknown (permanent T16 'unknown oldest' alert noise, settlement outbox never drains through the record); ResolveUnknown/alignment passes see terminal actions with non-terminal records
findings.fix_hint: GatedOCClaims must forward FinishOCDispatch/MarkOCDispatchSettled (embed the settle face or pass the raw *OCStore through) — one-line-ish container change; suite turns green with no other edits
findings.status: CLOSED by R20-authorized fix (GatedOCClaims forwards FinishOCDispatch/MarkOCDispatchSettled; probe + direct settle-face assertion green; end-state finding1_residue=null)
